<includeonly>{{#cargo_query:
tables=ObtainedFrom
|fields=SourceType,SourceKey,SourceText,Probability,IsGuaranteed,Quantity,SourceCondition
|where=ItemKey="{{{stablekey|}}}" AND Origin="generated"
|order by=SourceType ASC,SourceKey ASC
|format=template
|template=Item/ObtainedFromQueryRow
|named args=yes
|delimiter=<br />
|default=
}}</includeonly><noinclude>Renders item-owned obtainability rows from Cargo.</noinclude>
